name: fmp_available_indexes
description:
Market indexes covered by FMP, with their symbols, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/available-indexes as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the symbols with fmp_index_quote or fmp_index_historical.
Example: {}
